scope: Current party-feat state producer and synchronous capture boundary; no game/network execution or original/rebuilt parity.

native_ranges.name: context
native_ranges.contract: Optional context builder: retained remote presence, cached membership/events, death count and maximum modifiers.

native_ranges.name: members
native_ranges.contract: Ordered remote member projection: abandoned exclusion, unique maximum rank, talent bits.

native_ranges.name: tick-members
native_ranges.contract: Shared tick phase gate, clock advance and local-first member rebuild before simulation.

native_ranges.name: tick-simulation
native_ranges.contract: Later local/remote hero simulation and context swapping after member rebuild.

native_ranges.name: lethal-events
native_ranges.contract: Lethal boss metadata, ordinary hero event and shared copied-member event before subsequent callbacks.

native_ranges.name: death-phase
native_ranges.contract: Phase4 death owner and cooperative branch.

native_ranges.name: death-count
native_ranges.contract: Cooperative abandoned branch skips message and wrapping increment of shared death count.

native_ranges.name: death-init
native_ranges.contract: New Game death count initialized to0.

native_ranges.name: abandon
native_ranges.contract: Active phase1..3 abandon sets finished before entering death owner.

native_ranges.name: hero-swap
native_ranges.contract: Complete straight-line leaf swaps private hero fields; c77 maps to remote983, shared feat state omitted.

limits: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
Pseudocode is Ghidra decompiler output, not original source and not text-equivalent to Hopper output.
External functions and functions without an analyzable body return null; other decompiler failures remain explicit.
macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.
Headerless raw-binary analysis uses the caller-supplied architecture and entry address; file offset 0 is mapped at that address. Headers are not discovered from file bytes.

Little-endian generic Ghidra languages are used for x86, x86_64, arm, arm64, and NMOS 6502. Big-endian, Thumb-only, Cortex-M, 65C02, 65816, and other processor variants are unsupported in this increment.
Static analysis does not emulate reset vectors, memory-mapped I/O, or firmware boot sequences.
